name: Ooigawa Mamoru
source:
The protagonist's non-blood-related older brother. He has entrusted the house and store to his sister and works as a newspaper reporter. Mamoru always looks sleepy and has a listless attitude.

[From [url=http://otome-jikan.net/2013/04/17/getsuei-no-kusari/]Otome Jikan[/url]]
